open_questions: Centroid not localized: TESS difference imaging is inconclusive due to faint star (Tmag 13.41) and high neighbour density; high-resolution imaging and time-series ground photometry to confirm on-target origin.

Large transit-to-transit depth scatter (p_consistent 1.3630816692715465e-14, share_of_top_3 0.977) with one transit 23275 ppm vs one 1316 ppm; additional transits and RV mass measurement to rule out residual blend/scintillation systematics.
dossier.public_summary: TESS shows a 2-hour flat-bottom transit every 11.5 days implying a 4.2 Earth-radius planet on an M dwarf. The shape, duration and steady sector depth favour a planet over an eclipsing binary, despite scatter in individual transit depths and an inconclusive centroid at this faint magnitude. Faster follow-up imaging and mass measurements would confirm the planet.

reasons.why: Flat-bottomed, non-V shape favours a planet over a grazing EB or V-shaped binary; ingress fraction 0.05 with t14 2 h gives duration ratio 1.001 consistent with central transit.
With TIC radius 0.3297 Rsun the radius is planet-sized well below the giant-planet/brown-dwarf limit, and undiluted depth 13890 ppm supports it.

Sectors are steady (depth_change_pct 57.42 with p_constant 0.3311 and sector_depths_by_source verdict steady with p_constant 0.33099722440706003), so the signal does not vary apriori as expected for a planet despite large error bar in sector 54 (3764 ppm).
Observed 2 h matches central duration for this M dwarf (Teff 3289 K, Rad 0.3297, Mass 0.3107), positively favouring on-target geometry.

Individual depths scatter (chi2 74.20486739874974 dof 5) with one deep outlier at 23275 ppm (sigma +4.6) and one shallow 1316 ppm (sigma -4.6) argues against a systematic EB blend but is attributed to scintillation/systematics on a faint Tmag 13.41 target, not intrinsic depth change.
Odd/even difference is below the 4-sigma strong-EB threshold and secondary.snr 3.359 below 5 is not significant; with flat bottom the modest difference does not favour EBs over a planet.

Centroid_all returns inconclusive (no sector with a clear difference image) with neighbours plausible_within_1px 5 and could_cause 157, but no off-target localization and flat shape/duration consistency provide positive on-target evidence the scorer could not use, explaining xgboost planet_rank 0.11.
